title: Vickers Wellington NZ-N
memorial_details: Concrete foundation supporting a square-headed blue-brick wall with an engraved bronze plaque on front face. Crest at top centre of plaque.
inscription: HERE ON 27/28 MAY 1941 / A WELLINGTON BOMBER / NZ-N OF 304 (Silesian) Squadron / CRASHED AFTER BOMBING THE FRENCH / PORT OF BOLOGNE WHERE IT HAD BEEN / HIT AND BADLY DAMAGED / CREW WHO DIED / (3 NAMES) / (1 NAME) / DROWNED IN THE LA MANCHE CANAL / CREW WHO SURVIVED / (2 NAMES) / BALED OUT
custodian: Stanislaw Jozefiak; Polish Air Force Association Trust
community_connection: The memorial is maintained by Stanislaw Jozefiak; Polish Air Force Association Trust.
